turns.said: My printer queue is stuck and nothing prints.
turns.reply:
Hello Salma,

I looked into the printer queue issue and it is usually caused by a stalled print spooler service. You can clear the stuck queue by following these steps:

1. Confirm the printer is online, has paper, and has no error lights.
2. In your computer's search bar, type Services and open it. Find "Print Spooler" in the list, right-click it, and click "Stop".
3. Open File Explorer, navigate to C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS and delete all the files inside this folder.
4. Go back to Services, right-click "Print Spooler" again, and select "Start".

Could you please try these steps and let me know if a test page prints successfully?
